instruction: A clean, realistic photographic medium full shot of a bright ballet studio with wooden barres. Five children stand in a diagonal line along the barre. From left to right: the girl with light brown hair (R2), the red-haired girl in a bun (R3), the boy with short brown hair (R4), the blonde girl in a bun (R1), and the red-haired boy (R5). The girls wear pink leotards with matching skirts and white tights, while the boys wear dark blue t-shirts with black shorts. They all stand close together, holding or leaning against the wooden barre, looking forward or slightly down. Bright, even, soft indoor lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the dark floor.
